connector.name: Sprintra
connector.registryDescription: The project brain for AI coding agents - memory, decisions, sprints, knowledge base via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.sprintra.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sprintra-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VIBEPILOT_MODE
env.description: Runtime mode: 'local' for SQLite or 'saas' for PostgreSQL

env.name: SUPABASE_DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string (required for saas mode)

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key for decision conflict detection via embeddings (optional)
